title: Restore reliable signed-in visibility
summary: Successful sign-ins now stay on the roster because the shared hidden-state utility once again overrides visible component display rules after the 42.5 cascade refactor.
changes: Restores the authoritative hidden-state utility outside the legacy cascade so authenticated screens can reliably hide the sign-in gate and other inactive interface surfaces.
Fixes the 42.5 regression where Google and password authentication succeeded but the sign-in screen could remain visible over the authenticated roster.
Browser smoke setup now uses the production hidden class instead of forcing inline display styles, so this visibility regression is caught in future UI changes.
Architecture coverage now protects the hidden-state contract while preserving the lower-priority legacy CSS ownership introduced in 42.5.
